Here’s a list of well-known **office furniture brand websites** categorized by region and type (premium, mid-range, budget, and specialty):

---

### **🌍 Global & Premium Brands (High-End, Design-Focused)**
1. **Herman Miller** ([www.hermanmiller.com](https://www.hermanmiller.com))
   - Iconic ergonomic chairs (Aeron, Embody), modern office systems.
2. **Steelcase** ([www.steelcase.com](https://www.steelcase.com))
   - Workplace solutions, ergonomic seating (Gesture, Leap), and collaborative furniture.
3. **Knoll** ([www.knoll.com](https://www.knoll.com))
   - Designer furniture (Barcelona Chair, Saarinen Table), modern office systems.
4. **Haworth** ([www.haworth.com](https://www.haworth.com))
   - Ergonomic chairs (Zody, Fern), modular workstations.
5. **Vitra** ([www.vitra.com](https://www.vitra.com))
   - High-end European design (Eames, Panton Chair), office and home office.
6. **Hay** ([www.hay.dk](https://www.hay.dk))
   - Scandinavian design, affordable premium furniture (e.g., About A Chair).
7. **Fritz Hansen** ([www.fritzhansen.com](https://www.fritzhansen.com))
   - Danish design (Series 7 Chair, Egg Chair), luxury office furniture.
8. **Artek** ([www.artek.fi](https://www.artek.fi))
   - Finnish design (Alvar Aalto’s furniture), minimalist office pieces.
9. **B&B Italia** ([www.bebitalia.com](https://www.bebitalia.com))
   - Italian luxury furniture, executive desks, and lounge seating.
10. **Cassina** ([www.cassina.com](https://www.cassina.com))
    - High-end Italian design (LC4 Chaise, LC2 Sofa), executive offices.

---

### **🇺🇸 North America (Mid-Range & Commercial)**
11. **HON** ([www.hon.com](https://www.hon.com))
    - Affordable, durable office furniture (desks, chairs, storage).
12. **Global Furniture Group** ([www.globalfurnituregroup.com](https://www.globalfurnituregroup.com))
    - Commercial office solutions (workstations, seating).
13. **Teknion** ([www.teknion.com](https://www.teknion.com))
    - Modular office systems, ergonomic seating (e.g., Altos).
14. **Allsteel** ([www.allsteeloffice.com](https://www.allsteeloffice.com))
    - Workplace furniture (desks, storage, collaborative spaces).
15. **KI (Krueger International)** ([www.ki.com](https://www.ki.com))
    - Education, healthcare, and office furniture (e.g., Ruckus Chair).
16. **National Office Furniture** ([www.nationalofficefurniture.com](https://www.nationalofficefurniture.com))
    - Budget-friendly desks, chairs, and conference tables.
17. **Sauder** ([www.sauder.com](https://www.sauder.com))
    - Affordable home office furniture (desks, bookcases).
18. **Bush Furniture** ([www.bushfurniture.com](https://www.bushfurniture.com))
    - Budget office desks, storage, and home office solutions.
19. **Lorell** ([www.lorell.com](https://www.lorell.com))
    - Mid-range office furniture (chairs, desks, filing cabinets).
20. **OFM** ([www.ofm.com](https://www.ofm.com))
    - Affordable office chairs, desks, and reception furniture.

---

### **🇪🇺 Europe (Mid-Range & Design-Oriented)**
21. **IKEA** ([www.ikea.com](https://www.ikea.com))
    - Budget-friendly home/office furniture (BEKANT, IDÅSEN desks).
22. **Sedus** ([www.sedus.com](https://www.sedus.com))
    - German ergonomic chairs (e.g., se:do, swing up).
23. **Wilkhahn** ([www.wilkhahn.com](https://www.wilkhahn.com))
    - High-quality ergonomic chairs (e.g., ON, Modus).
24. **Okamura** ([www.okamura.com](https://www.okamura.com))
    - Japanese office furniture (ergonomic chairs, workstations).
25. **Kinnarps** ([www.kinnarps.com](https://www.kinnarps.com))
    - Scandinavian office solutions (sustainable furniture).
26. **Flokk** ([www.flokk.com](https://www.flokk.com))
    - Norwegian brand (HÅG, RH, Giroflex chairs).
27. **Vitra (Europe)** ([www.vitra.com](https://www.vitra.com))
    - Same as global, but with EU-specific products.
28. **USM Haller** ([www.usm.com](https://www.usm.com))
    - Modular storage and office systems (Swiss design).
29. **Lammhults** ([www.lammhults.com](https://www.lammhults.com))
    - Swedish design, office and public space furniture.
30. **Bene** ([www.bene.com](https://www.bene.com))
    - Austrian office furniture (workstations, acoustic solutions).

---

### **🇬🇧 UK & Ireland**
31. **Orangebox** ([www.orangebox.com](https://www.orangebox.com))
    - UK-based ergonomic chairs (e.g., Do, ARA).
32. **Senator** ([www.senator-group.com](https://www.senator-group.com))
    - Office furniture (desks, seating, storage).
33. **KI Europe** ([www.ki.com/uk](https://www.ki.com/uk))
    - Same as US, but UK-focused.
34. **Boss Design** ([www.boss-design.com](https://www.boss-design.com))
    - UK seating and office furniture.
35. **Connection** ([www.connectionseating.com](https://www.connectionseating.com))
    - Collaborative and flexible office furniture.

---

### **🇦🇺 Australia & New Zealand**
36. **Zenith Interiors** ([www.zenithinteriors.com](https://www.zenithinteriors.com))
    - Australian office furniture (workstations, seating).
37. **Jardan** ([www.jardan.com.au](https://www.jardan.com.au))
    - High-end Australian design (office and residential).
38. **Krost** ([www.krost.com.au](https://www.krost.com.au))
    - Commercial office furniture (desks, storage).
39. **Schamburg + Alvisse** ([www.schamburg.com.au](https://www.schamburg.com.au))
    - Australian-made office furniture.

---

### **🇨🇳 Asia (Manufacturing & Budget Options)**
40. **UE Furniture** ([www.uefurniture.com](https://www.uefurniture.com))
    - Chinese manufacturer (OEM for global brands).
41. **Sunon** ([www.sunon.com](https://www.sunon.com))
    - Chinese office furniture (desks, chairs).
42. **Kinnarps Asia** ([www.kinnarps.asia](https://www.kinnarps.asia))
    - Scandinavian design in Asia.
43. **Okamura Asia** ([www.okamura.com.sg](https://www.okamura.com.sg))
    - Japanese office furniture in Asia.

---

### **🛒 Online Retailers (Multi-Brand Stores)**
44. **Wayfair** ([www.wayfair.com](https://www.wayfair.com))
    - Huge selection of office furniture (budget to mid-range).
45. **Amazon Business** ([www.amazon.com/business](https://www.amazon.com/business))
    - Bulk office furniture purchases.
46. **Furniture At Work** ([www.furniture-work.co.uk](https://www.furniture-work.co.uk))
    - UK-based office furniture retailer.
47. **Office Depot / OfficeMax** ([www.officedepot.com](https://www.officedepot.com))
    - US-based office supplies and furniture.
48. **Staples** ([www.staples.com](https://www.staples.com))
    - Office furniture and supplies.
49. **West Elm** ([www.westelm.com](https://www.westelm.com))
    - Stylish home office furniture.
50. **CB2** ([www.cb2.com](https://www.cb2.com))
    - Modern office furniture (desks, chairs).

---

### **🔍 Specialty & Niche Brands**
- **Ergonomic Chairs:**
  - **Humanscale** ([www.humanscale.com](https://www.humanscale.com)) – Freedom Chair, Diffrient Smart.
  - **Secretlab** ([www.secretlab.co](https://www.secretlab.co)) – Gaming/office chairs.
  - **Autonomous** ([www.autonomous.ai](https://www.autonomous.ai)) – SmartDesk, ErgoChair.
- **Standing Desks:**
  - **Uplift Desk** ([www.upliftdesk.com](https://www.upliftdesk.com))
  - **Fully** ([www.fully.com](https://www.fully.com)) – Jarvis Desk.
  - **FlexiSpot** ([www.flexispot.com](https://www.flexispot.com))
- **Acoustic & Privacy Furniture:**
  - **Framery** ([www.frameryacoustics.com](https://www.frameryacoustics.com)) – Phone booths.
  - **BuzziSpace** ([www.buzzispace.com](https://www.buzzispace.com)) – Acoustic pods.
- **Sustainable/Eco-Friendly:**
  - **Emeco** ([www.emeco.net](https://www.emeco.net)) – Recycled aluminum chairs.
  - **VivaTerra** ([www.vivaterra.com](https://www.vivaterra.com)) – Eco-friendly furniture.

---

### **💡 Tips for Choosing Office Furniture**
- **Ergonomics:** Prioritize adjustable chairs (e.g., Herman Miller Aeron, Steelcase Gesture).
- **Budget:** IKEA, Sauder, and Wayfair offer affordable options.
- **Space Planning:** Modular systems (Steelcase, Teknion) work well for open offices.
- **Sustainability:** Look for FSC-certified wood or recycled materials (e.g., Emeco, Kinnarps).

Would you like recommendations for a specific type of furniture (e.g., ergonomic chairs, standing desks, conference tables)?
